name: ABAS SATHI (আবাসসাথী) - Apartment Management
description: ABAS SATHI 6.0.3 — performance adaptation candidate with shared in-flight reads, module cache retention, dashboard summary bootstrap, and privacy-safe API/backend timing logs. Existing permissions and accounting logic retained.
majorCapabilities: Authenticated Google Sheets CRUD
Private Drive document management
Automated backup and guarded restore
Server-side financial reports and journal ledger
Role and society isolation
Database-faithful property area display
Lease period date formatting
Enhanced invoice register and outstanding dues
Resident invoice balances from confirmed Fund Inflow and Bill Wise Details
Resident scoped My Receipts and allocation details
Formatted resident invoice preview and print-to-PDF
Ownership-period-wise outstanding report
Quick Login with remembered non-secret identifiers
Backend-validated session restore and sliding session expiry
Idempotent retry for eligible live write operations
Batch Central Master lookup and Drive upload pre-validation
Mobile-safe CORS POST transport with bounded retry and diagnostics
Corrected default Apps Script deployment URL migration
Single-request dashboard data bootstrap to reduce mobile round trips
Admin year-end closing and account-wise cash/bank reconciliation
Fund Balance Register with previous-year closing carry-forward
Dashboard opening fund balance from Fund Balance Register and live cash-basis receipts/payments
Reduced login to one authentication request by removing redundant immediate profile validation
Short-lived role-aware server session profile cache with explicit invalidation on user updates
20-second role-scoped dashboard response cache with payload-size guard
Bounded dashboard loading for recent activity, notices, gallery and preventive maintenance
15-second in-memory module cache for faster repeat navigation
Targeted TextFinder login lookup with validated short-lived row-index cache
Drive upload I/O moved outside the global Apps Script lock
Six-hour cached private society Drive folder reference
Operation ledger lookup optimized to read only the matching operation row
File conversion uses ArrayBuffer to avoid an extra Data URL copy
